The '''Nek'mani Wellspring''' is a sacred spring located high in the cliffs overlooking the [[Southern Savage Coast]] in southwestern [[Stranglethorn Vale]]. The spring is the subject of great conflict among religious scholars, since every race in [[Azeroth (continent)|Azeroth]] claims that the waters were made divine for their people. An expedition of naga explorers have recently advanced on the spring.<ref>{{questlong|Horde|44|Mok'thardin's Enchantment (4)}}</ref>
